newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU confirms clears John Deere/Lombard deal.
newsitem.headline: EU confirms clears John Deere/Lombard deal.

text.p: The European Commission said on Tuesday it had cleared a joint venture between John Deere Capital Corporation, controlled by Deere & Company of the U.S., and Lombard North Central Plc to supply financing for the lease, hire and purchase of farm equipment and supplies in Britain.

It said in a statement that the deal would not harm fair competition since the two partners currently operate in different markets: the supply of agricultural products for Deere and financial services for Lombard.
Under the terms of the operation, John Deere Capital and Lombard, a subsidiary of National Westminster Bank Plc, acquire joint control of John Deere Credit Ltd.

The Commission said in its statement that the venture would have a "low share" of the market for financing agricultural products and would face established competitors. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
